purpose: X4S-3 qualification only: K4S-none(R3a) on X4S qualification seeds 4503604827370496+[0,2) vs X4S receipt nodeadline-equality.json
status: exploration only; NEVER ADOPTABLE; no student here enters any frozen manifest (SD1 stays R3a)

bootstrap.unit: paired seed, stratified by arm (each resampled seed carries both arms)

lateness.play: reserve at decision tick, command due=decision tick+27+overrun_ticks
lateness.wait: wait interval starts at decision tick+overrun_ticks; own poll channel unavailable until then
lateness.opponent: v1 has no search deadline; unchanged cadence
lateness.emulation: deadline sweep preserves 8ms reserve and real-time delay ticks; budget equivalence only, not hardware underclocking

student.status: R3a control (existing checkpoint, no fit); killed in R3 Stage 1; NEVER ADOPTABLE

R3a-rep.role: fit-seed noise floor (R3a G-04 rows not on 01; disclosed)

R4-DC.role: data + compute (optional, last; skipped if R4-D minus R3a point estimate >= 0)

recipe: R3a: init v1 d77005d5, width 192, root-only (teacher ratio 1), listwise T=0.003, play weight 1, value weight 0, advantage 0, AdamW 3e-4 wd .05, warmup 2000 + cosine, batch 8192, microbatch 3584, EMA 0.999, final EMA only; trainer exit-r3/source (freeze bc542da8), loader6/prefetch4, eager, bf16 autocast
calibration: R3 rule: threshold on P(gate=play) with a legal play nearest 34.6% deterministic root play on the 8,088 eligible roots of ExIt R1 held-out64 slice 0ecce0f0; midpoints between sorted distinct probabilities; smaller threshold on ties; label-free; GPU float32 TF32 off

compute.game_physical_cores: 0-49 (10 five-core K4S-120 slots, or 50 one-core S-200 lanes); SMT siblings unassigned

ordering.blocks: one game per block: each phase runs one arm for one student over all 1,200 indices in increasing order; K4S-120 phases use 5-core slots, S-200 phases 1-core lanes
ordering.interrupted: a game of an interrupted block is excluded; its seed is retired for every later phase and never re-run; reduction uses only seeds terminal in every reduced (student, arm)

readout.primary: loss(R4-D) minus loss(R3a), paired by seed, pooled over K4S-120 and S-200 with equal arm weight; each arm also separately
readout.data_helps: upper95CI(R4-D minus R3a, pooled) < 0 AND point(R4-D minus R3a-rep, pooled) < 0
readout.also: cutoff %, student-default %, play %, wall p50/p99, overrun % per student and arm; R4-DC minus R4-D if run
readout.stop_rule: fixed N; a student contrast is reduced only after all 2x1,200 of its games are terminal
